newspaper.headline: Weekly Releases Begin
newspaper.lead: Starting this week, the Nusa Digital developer team releases app updates every Thursday. The new developer now helps watch releases and may decide to roll back.

impact.good: Yesterday, every bug users reported was fixed with green tests. Users of the report card and shop apps praised the fixes.
impact.mixed: Yesterday, some bugs were fixed, but a few came back. The team was asked to use print() more carefully when debugging.
impact.bad: Yesterday, many bug fixes were left unfinished. Some users still hit the same errors.

tip.title: Tip: Roll Back First, Fix Later
tip.text: If a new release makes errors jump, go back to the healthy version first. Users don't have to wait for the fix.

newspaper.classified: FOR SALE: Used time machine, only goes back to the previous commit. — Release Team

boss.title: Release Night
boss.intro: Big release tonight! Review the last PRs carefully and finish the speed challenge.
